<parameter=code>
def nbar():
    for n in current_frame.segmentation['nodes']:

    return None
def player():
    b=[n for n in current_frame.segmentation['nodes'] if n['pixels']==8 and n['color']=='b'][0]
    bc=[p[1] for p in b['boundary']]; return (min(bc),max(bc))
print("before:", "N",nbar(),"player",player(),"step",current_frame.step)
action(['LEFT'])
print("after LEFT:", "N",nbar(),"player",player(),"step",current_frame.step)
print("result:", {k:last_action_result.get(k) for k in ['board_changed','done','level_completed','game_over','state','action_num']})
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
